scope: Required T23–T29 remaining work. Authored criteria and executed bounded anchors are distinct from whole-project, learner, independent or physical validation.

gaps.work: All 258 criterion-specific learner artifacts, evidence reviews and delayed variants remain unattempted. The per-domain remaining records enumerate each criterion. No seven-day assessment interval has been fabricated.

Inspect the exact published C17/C23 and relevant POSIX editions before making edition-specific claims beyond inspected N1570 and the selected primary interface pages. Private TLPI/CS:APP and other book passages are not newly inspected.

The new launcher executes ordinary exec/exit/signal and two parent acquisition failures. Forced EINTR, deliberately partial child error records, premature pre-exec death, crossed redirection and inherited-grandchild pipe writers remain required learner experiments. No unconditional EOF certificate is claimed.
Run scripted short-I/O/EINTR/EAGAIN resumption and checked off_t extent probes against learner code. The old copy anchor does not force all these schedules or prove large-file support.

Inspect the chosen full-resolution confinement API and filesystem policy, then implement the original contained TOCTOU demonstration and its repaired comparison. Metadata/default-ACL and intermediate-symlink cases remain unexecuted; no current external target is authorized.

Complete mapping fault/truncation source inspection, owned-child fault cases, unrelated-process attachment, owner-death initialization and process-shared publication. The retained fork/wait native-header roundtrip is only partial support.
Execute full pipeline ownership, PTY VMIN/VTIME/restoration and deadline cases. PTY results cannot establish physical baud, electrical levels, RS485 turnaround or external-device behavior.

Exercise the learner persistence adapter with write/fsync/directory-sync failures and declared crash-cut models. Do not claim physical media durability from namespace visibility, host simulation or a successful write.

Run actual clock/deadline, accumulated timerfd/eventfd counts and child-only resource-limit cases with supported interfaces. Injected wall-clock changes use an adapter; no host clock or policy change is authorized.

Inspect exact async-signal-safe/restart/wait interfaces and execute controlled lost-wakeup, self-pipe/signalfd, coalescing and mask-restoration cases. The retained synchronous signal anchor is not complete signal integration.

Implement local-only address fallback, partial framing, datagram truncation and peer-disappearance cases. The closure oracle and AF_UNIX bounded reply do not establish all TCP/UDP/address-ownership contracts.

Exercise ET drain/runnable retention, stale descriptor generation, fairness, overload and shutdown schedules with the learner event loop. Existing poll/epoll anchors retain their bounded scopes; full service behavior is still assessed separately.

Complete the required T62 io_uring/sendfile adapter composition using installed operation/version support and target-completion ownership. Unsupported kernel operations remain unavailable cells, not an excuse to remove the topic.

Beyond the executed joinable successful-prefix anchor, implement detached completion ownership, creator cancellation recovery and C/POSIX signature/support comparisons. Recoverable join failure requires retained storage and a separate policy.

Run controlled transaction, enrollment, spurious wakeup, timed wait, close, cancellation and primitive-selection cases. Replace sleep-based enrollment assumptions with explicit schedule evidence where required.

Complete the concrete C memory-model graphs, lock-free/helper audits, CAS spurious-failure model and compiler/target comparisons. Clean stress or sanitizer output cannot classify all permitted executions.

Run forced deadlock/livelock/starvation schedules, equivalent-work false-sharing measurements and known-race/logical sensitivity controls. The new lifecycle TSan observations do not validate all learner queue schedules or performance claims.

Complete the explicit required SPSC and bounded MPMC/reclamation implementation gates and leaf-specific history/model witnesses. Existing exact-once stress and retained models are partial support. Broader hazard, epoch and RCU proofs/selected APIs need further source inspection.

Inspect the selected LKMM/RCU/context contracts and execute original T57 teaching modules in a disposable version-matched guest. Kernel headers/configuration and guest execution were not established in this wave. No host module loading or production target is authorized.

Inspect exact current part/package datasheet, board schematic/revision, errata and selected vendor startup/linker sources. Historical RM0090 Rev21 and the Arm core manual do not supply these missing identities or electrical details.

Complete learner image/link-closure, startup fault, retained-record reset cuts and available-target observations. Cold/watchdog/debugger reset, actual stack margins and hardware retention remain physical gaps; no board flashing was performed.

Complete leaf-specific register side-effect, clock, GPIO, UART, timer, SPI, I2C and ADC failure/changed-target investigations. Selected RM passages support construction but do not validate actual electrical settling, waveform accuracy, pull networks or complete peripheral sections.

Complete DMA reachability, generation, cancellation/quiescence, cache ownership and service-layer composition on each selected target. Host state machines and memory barriers do not establish physical device completion or cache-coherent transfers.

Implement the bounded Ethernet diagnostic adapter and its T39 integration. CAN and USB remain required separate routes; Ethernet does not cover arbitration, transceiver behavior, enumeration or endpoint ownership.

Execute frame variants, priority/mask nesting, ISR queue ownership, counter-coherence and controlled interrupt schedules on available targets. Physical latency, tail chaining, device ordering and worst-case bounds require actual target evidence beyond the finite hosted models.
